title: Make desktop icons and desktop widgets live on the same layer so they can't overlap one another
line: Dropping a desktop icon on a widget now places it in the nearest free spot beside the widget instead of hiding it underneath.
explanation: Desktop icons (the Folder View grid) and widgets (the applets layout) are separate layers that don't know about each other, so an icon dragged onto a widget was stored in a cell underneath it. There it could not be seen or clicked, only reached by rubber-band selection. When icons are moved on the desktop, the target cell's icon and label area is now checked against the widgets layout (AppletsLayout.isRectAvailable); if a widget covers it, the icon goes to the nearest free cell that no widget covers.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: don't drop icons under desktop widgets

Icons and widgets live on separate layers, so an icon could be dropped
under a widget, where it can't be seen or clicked anymore. Dropping an
icon on a widget now puts it in the nearest free cell next to it instead.

BUG: 519851
